title: fix(hono,runtime)!: createHonoApp keeps a repeated query name as an array, so the dispatcher refuses it; /packages refuses a repeated keepData or overwrite
body:
Fixes #23214
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Slice 2 of this card, built under seat ruling `6165288468` (Q1 B, Q2 A, Q3 A) and claim `6165302054`. Slice 1 (PR #23263, landed as `d45d0e938a`) guarded the dispatcher's read points. This PR guards the two `/packages` write flags that slice 1's census did not name, then flips the adapter: the order "guard first, then flip" is met inside one PR.

## What changes

**`@objectstack/hono`: the catch-all keeps a repeated query name.** `createHonoApp`'s `${prefix}/*` catch-all built the dispatcher's query with `URLSearchParams.forEach` into an object, so `?package=a&package=b` reached `HttpDispatcher.dispatch()` as `'b'`. Every arity rule the dispatcher declares was unreachable on a `createHonoApp` host. It now reads the query through `readDispatchQuery`, a module-private mirror of `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`'s `readQuery` (that one is module-private, and that package's `exports` has only `.`). It uses `c.req.queries()` with the length normalisation (one value stays a string, a repeat is the array) and `Object.fromEntries`, never a dynamic write, so `?__proto__=x` is an own key and no prototype moves. The docblock names the twin and the #6878 ruling. The catch arms are untouched; #23365 is not addressed here.

**`@objectstack/runtime`: `/packages` refuses a repeated `keepData` or `overwrite`.** Both were read as `query?.NAME === 'true'`, so a repeat read as absent:
- `DELETE /packages/:id?keepData=true&keepData=true` answered `200` and `deletePackage` received no `keepData`. The protocol keeps object storage only for `keepData === true`, so the tables the caller asked to keep were dropped. This was measured on a `plugin-hono-server` host before this PR, through the explicit `/packages` mount. Today's `createHonoApp` keeps them (last value), so the flip alone would have carried the drop to a second door.
- `POST /packages?overwrite=true&overwrite=true` answered `409` "already exists" for a package one `overwrite=true` replaces.

Both now refuse a repeat with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` and `repeatedQueryParamMessage`, as the domain already refuses `enabled` and `version`. Each refusal sits after the two authorization gates (the capability gate and the wall) and before any registry or protocol call. A one-element array is one occurrence and is unwrapped in place, as the `status`/`type` rule does (`refuseRepeatedWriteFlag`, module-private).

## The order lesson, re-measured

- On `origin/main` `823da2f21c`, a static census of every non-comment query read in the 22 domain modules and the `@objectstack/rest` helpers they call, plus a host map and empirical `dispatch()` probes with the post-flip array shape (os-dev-report `6165233131`), found:
  - no read point added since slice 1;
  - two unguarded `/packages` write flags, the ones this PR guards.
- Re-checked at `61b12584f0`: the 5 commits since `823da2f21c` touch none of `packages/runtime`, `packages/rest`, `packages/adapters`, `plugin-hono-server` or `http-conformance` (diff stat: 0 lines).
- #23265 (in flight in `domains/data.ts`, a different file) adds a `DELETE /data/:object/:id ?expectedVersion` read point that refuses a repeat. It is not on `main` and is not part of this PR.

## Pins

- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-query-multiplicity.test.ts` (15 tests, over the package's recording stub):
  - a repeated name reaches `dispatch()` as the array of its values;
  - nine single-valued inputs (plain, `+`, `%20`, a UTF-8 escape, a percent-encoded key, an empty value, a bare flag, a comma list, none) arrive exactly as the OLD line produced them, compared against a reference Hono app running that line;
  - `__proto__`, once and repeated, is an own key with `Object.prototype` untouched.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-query-multiplicity.conformance.test.ts` (7 tests): a REAL `createHonoApp` over the REAL `HttpDispatcher`, composed as its six `hono-*` siblings are. It lives here because `packages/adapters/hono/vitest.config.ts` aliases `@objectstack/runtime` to a stub for that whole suite. It pins:
  - `GET /meta/app/crm?package=a&package=b` refused `400` before `getMetaItem`;
  - `GET /packages` with a repeated `status` or `enabled` refused `400`;
  - `DELETE /packages/:id?keepData=true&keepData=true` refused `400` with `deletePackage` never called;
  - a single-value control for each, asserting what the service received.

  Refusals assert status, nested `error.code` `VALIDATION_ERROR`, and the named parameter with its count ("supplied 2 times"). This is not `query-multiplicity.conformance.test.ts`, which is untouched (ruling item 3).
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-write-flag-arity.test.ts` (11 tests, through `dispatch()` over a real `SchemaRegistry`):
  - three `keepData` repeat shapes refused, with neither `deletePackage` nor `registry.getPackage` called;
  - one `keepData` (`'true'`, `'1'`, `['true']`, absent) reaches `deletePackage` as `{ packageId, keepData: true }` or `{ packageId }`;
  - a repeated `overwrite` refused, with neither `installPackage` nor `registry.getPackage` called;
  - one `overwrite` (`'true'`, `['true']`) overwrites with `201`;
  - a control: no `overwrite` is still `409`.

## Ablations (one-time proofs; no permanent test files)

1. **The flip.** `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, restore on exit) put the old `forEach` construction back in `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`.
   - Anchor x1 → x0, blob `4089af0a973d` → `6948cd6354ba`.
   - No build leg: the hono pin file imports `./index` from source, and http-conformance aliases `@objectstack/hono` (`/^@objectstack\/hono$/`) to `src/index.ts`.
   - Hono pin file: **6 failed, 9 passed**. The 4 array-shape and 2 `__proto__` cases went red; all 9 single-value controls stayed green.
   - Conformance file: **4 failed, 3 passed**. Every refusal went red; every control stayed green.
   - Restore: blob == HEAD (`4089af0a973d`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
2. **The `keepData` guard.** The guard call in `domains/packages.ts` was disabled behind a marker property, in HOLD mode inside a script with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap.
   - Anchor x1 → x0, blob `20fc9b7cd2c2` → `ecba3c0a4be4`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build`.
   - `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files. The conformance file reads runtime through `dist/`.
   - Runtime pin file: **4 failed, 7 passed**. The three `keepData` refusals went red, plus the one-element-array preservation (the unwrap is the guard's own); every `overwrite` case stayed green.
   - Conformance file: **1 failed, 6 passed** (the `keepData` refusal).
   - Restore: blob == HEAD (`20fc9b7cd2c2`), rebuild, `--absent` preflight (marker absent from all 6 built files; whole tree clean).

## Tests and gates (head `99c7c050b2`, after merging `origin/main` `7b3d5585ca`)

All runs went through `os-verify-lock` (slot `issue-23214-s2`), each with `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- **Post-merge, at `99c7c050b2`:**
  - closure rebuild `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/http-conformance^...' --concurrency=2`: 36/36 tasks;
  - runtime `packages-write-flag-arity.test.ts` plus slice 1's `dispatcher-query-arity.test.ts`: 44 passed;
  - `@objectstack/hono` test: 7 files / 154 passed, and typecheck exit 0 (both configs; the test files are under `src/**`);
  - `@objectstack/http-conformance` test: 12 files / 124 passed, and typecheck exit 0 (test-layer ledger held at 3 files / 27 errors / 10 signatures);
  - `@objectstack/runtime` typecheck: exit 0, ledger held at 27 / 190 / 68;
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- **Runtime full local suite** at `e5da6a04aa` (runtime source identical to this head): 374 files, 5466 passed / 19 skipped.
- **Gate union:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derives 63 commands at `99c7c050b2`. All 63 were run, each exit captured before any pipe: **63 exit 0**. `--ran`: "63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". On a pre-merge head the union reddened `check-registry-log-declared`, because the conformance file constructed a `SchemaRegistry` in a suite that declares no registry log level; the rows now use the three-method double.
- **Lint**, as the proven narrowing over the 5 changed `.ts` files:
  1. Population: `eslint.config.mjs:971`'s block covers them all, and none is ignored.
  2. Count: `--format json` with `--no-inline-config` gives 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 fatal (eslint exit 0).
  3. Invariance: no type-aware linting (`:328`), so no untouched file's verdict can move.

## Acceptance notes

- **Excluded by ruling Q3 → A:** each of these already answers a repeat exactly as its canonical, already array-fed twin does, so the flip opens no divergence.
  - P3 `GET /analytics/meta ?cube` (typeof: a repeat reads as absent, an unscoped list). Twin: the `dispatcher-plugin` `/analytics/meta` mount.
  - P4 the share-link list (`?object`, `?recordId`, `?includeRevoked`) and resolve (`?email`, `?password`) names (typeof or `=== 'true'`: a repeat reads as absent). Twin: `plugin-sharing`'s share-link routes.
- **One malformed input moves the other way.** A query pair with an EMPTY name (`?=x`) is dropped by hono's parser, so it no longer reaches the dispatcher. Measured through a real `createHonoApp`: `GET /api/v1/meta/app/crm?=x` was `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` ('The "" query parameter is not supported…') with the old line, and is `200` now. `plugin-hono-server`'s `readQuery` already drops it the same way, so this converges the two Hono doors. It is stated in the changeset. The ruled `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` line is kept; whether this input changes that line is the seat's to say.
- **Multi-valued names.** Names such as `select` and `expand` now reach the dispatcher as arrays on a `createHonoApp` host, exactly as `RestServer` hands them to `findData` / `getData` through `plugin-hono-server`.
- **Not changed in this PR:**
  - The domain's inline `status`/`type` loop (slice 1) could adopt `refuseRepeatedWriteFlag`; it is outside this claim's surface.
  - Slice 1's changeset (`.changeset/23214-dispatcher-query-arity.md`, unreleased) still says the refusals are reachable only through `dispatch()` until this adapter keeps repeats. It is outside this claim's surface; this PR's changeset states the new reach.
- **hono version.** `c.req.queries()`'s null-prototype record is what keeps `__proto__` as an own key on the installed hono 4.13.12. On the peer-range floor 4.12.8 (read statically), hono's own parser drops a `__proto__` name, so the pin is a reading of the installed version. No prototype is polluted on either.
